overview: TableFlow is a French-first booking and guest management back office for independent restaurants and spas, with a public booking page guests can use without an account.
features: Sign in and manage a venue with owner, manager and staff roles
Four-step venue setup with opening hours, booking defaults and a unique public link
Restaurant planning with service tabs, covers counters, list and timeline views
Automatic table suggestion and protection against double bookings
Public booking page with waitlist fallback and a guest self-service manage page
Guest CRM with search, filters, automatic tags, merge, CSV import and export
Floor plan editor and a live tablet floor view
Email confirmations and reminders for bookings
French and English interface with a seeded demo restaurant
